visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair wearing a black tank top sits on a brown couch. She raises both arms in excitement. In front of her on a white table are several books, postcards, and a black bag. (2) Quick cuts show a poster of a man in a top hat titled 'CHOPIN' on a building and then the woman waving in front of a mural with a man in glasses. (3) Back to the couch, she holds up a small yellow and white media badge. She smiles and gestures with her hands while speaking. (4) She picks up a thick white book and flips through the pages, revealing photographs of various young men and women. The pages move quickly. (5) She holds up a black coffee bag with a blue label and a piano keyboard illustration at the bottom. She points to the label. (6) She displays several postcards, one showing a bust in a museum and another showing a white house with a green roof. (7) Historical-style illustrations of a family in 19th-century attire standing in front of a house appear, followed by a woman and a child inside a room. (8) The woman on the couch opens a blue and white box of playing cards. She fans them out, showing cards with portraits of historical figures. (9) A top-down view shows the playing cards scattered on a table. Various character graphics with speech bubbles appear over them. (10) She picks up a small colorful notepad and flips its white pages. Then, she unboxes a black notebook with a portrait of a man in a circle on the cover. (11) The scene shifts to a concert hall. Several different pianists are shown playing a black grand piano on a stage. An overhead shot shows the large audience and judges' table. (12) The woman returns to the couch, gesturing towards the camera with both hands, looking enthusiastic before waving goodbye.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice speaks rapidly over a rhythmic pop-piano BGM. The voice is bright and enthusiastic. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the visuals cut to Poland. (3) The female voice continues at a high pitch; a crisp 'ding' sound occurs as she displays the media badge. (4) Audible rustling and rhythmic 'flicker' sounds correspond to the flipping of book pages. (5) Plastic crinkling sounds are prominent as she handles the coffee bag. (6) A series of rapid percussive 'click' sounds play as she fans out the playing cards. (7) An 'OMG' exclamation is layered with a comic 'sparkle' sound effect. (8) Short bursts of canned laughter and cartoonish 'spring' sound effects are used for comedic emphasis during the playing card segment. (9) A metallic 'clink' and 'pop' sound occur as the notebook is unboxed. (10) The BGM transitions into a dramatic, high-fidelity piano solo as footage of the competition plays, ending with a low-volume applause track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Experience Recap -> Detailed Unboxing -> Call to Action -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share the creator's personal excitement and professional experience attending the International Chopin Piano Competition in Poland. By unboxing exclusive merchandise like books, coffee, and playing cards, she provides a 'souvenir' experience for her audience while promoting interest in the prestigious musical event.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly mentions being invited by the 'Poland in Taiwan Office' and showcases various branded products related to the Chopin competition.
